title: Pure Allure Queen
summary: Pure Allure Queen with Terraforming and generic staples. Allure Queen is a Spellcaster LV archetype that equips monsters as protection shields while climbing from LV3 to LV7; the 2024 support (Allure Palace, Allure Dance and Chaos Allure Queen) turns the slow Standby Phase level-up into a single-turn Link and swarm engine.

summary.title: Starters
points: Allure Palace (searchable by Terraforming and Allure Dance) sends a card from your hand to the GY up to three times per turn to search an Allure Queen monster or Special Summon one from the Deck to the opponent's field.

Allure Dance searches an Allure Queen monster or Allure Palace on activation, and sends another Spell/Trap you control to the GY to Special Summon as many Allure Queen monsters equipped to your monsters as possible.
Chaos Allure Queen discards any LIGHT or DARK monster to Special Summon itself from the hand, then equips an Allure Queen from either GY to itself and copies that monster's name.

summary.title: Opening: Allure Palace or Allure Dance
steps: Activate Allure Dance to search Allure Palace (or activate Allure Palace directly), then use Allure Palace to send an Allure Queen from your hand to the GY and search Chaos Allure Queen.
Discard a LIGHT or DARK monster to Special Summon Chaos Allure Queen from the hand, and use its effect to equip an Allure Queen from the GY to itself.

Because Chaos Allure Queen copied that Allure Queen's name and is now equipped with a monster by its own effect, use the effect granted by Allure Palace to send it to the GY and Special Summon the next higher LV Allure Queen from your hand or Deck.
Use Allure Dance to Special Summon equipped Allure Queen monsters from your Spell & Trap Zone, then Link Summon Golden Allure Queen.

summary.title: LV Climb & Equip Mechanics
summary.text: Traditionally, Allure Queen LV3 and LV5 had to equip an opponent's monster and survive until your next Standby Phase to level up. Allure Palace bypasses both restrictions: it can summon an Allure Queen to the opponent's field so LV3 or LV5 has a valid target on turn 1, and it gives every Allure Queen equipped by its own effect an ignition effect to send itself to the GY immediately to Special Summon the next LV from the hand or Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Golden Allure Queen (Link-3) Special Summons an Allure Queen from the Deck or GY on Link Summon and gains 1500 ATK, makes all effects of your Allure Queen monsters that equip monsters into Quick Effects on the opponent's turn, and destroys a card on the field whenever an opponent's card is equipped while protecting your Allure Queens from destruction.
Allure Queen LV7, LV5 and LV3 become Quick Effect non-destruction removal on the opponent's turn while Golden Allure Queen is on the field, absorbing opposing monsters into your Spell & Trap Zone.
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World, I:P Masquerena and S:P Little Knight convert the extra bodies generated by Allure Dance and Golden Allure Queen into additional disruption.
